verdict.rationale: QuickBooks provides the underlying building blocks — automatic transaction matching, bank-feed import, and discrepancy/reconciliation reports (quickbooks-docs-6,7,8,9) — plus an official MCP server exposing 145 tools with full CRUD over 29 entities and 11 financial reports that an AI agent could use to inspect and reconcile accounts (quickbooks-gh-3, quickbooks-gh-4), and an 'Intuit Intelligence' chat assistant that can 'help resolve anomalies' (quickbooks-docs-19). However, there is no documented end-to-end agentic reconciliation workflow that autonomously matches a full month, flags exceptions, and stages a close for human sign-off — it must be assembled from separate primitives. Missing for 10: an explicit packaged 'agent reconciles month-end' feature/workflow, evidence of automated exception-flagging logic beyond generic anomaly help, and any documented 'prepare for review' close-staging output.
